description:
Pelli is the all-in-one back office for professional photographers: client galleries, CRM, quotes, invoices, contracts, bookings, gift cards and marketing. Connect your Pelli account to ChatGPT and run your studio in plain language.

What you can do
- See where your business stands: revenue, unpaid invoices, upcoming appointments, gallery views and client activity.
- Prepare paperwork faster: draft quotes, invoices and deposit invoices, and review every document before anything is sent.
- Keep your CRM tidy: find clients, add contacts and notes, organize your task board.
- Manage galleries and bookings: create galleries, give clients access, adjust your services and availability.

Safe by design
- You choose the permissions when you connect: view only, create and edit, and — only if you turn it on — send documents to your clients and record payments.
- Document and business actions support previews before confirmation. Sending to clients requires a matching preview and the send permission. Automation tools only create or edit inactive drafts; activation happens in Pelli.
- Pelli never moves money: it records payments you already received and sends invoices you approved.
- See every action and disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Pelli › Settings › AI assistants.

Requires a Pelli Pro or Ultra account.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my studio this month: revenue, unpaid invoices and upcoming shoots
Draft a quote for my next wedding client
Which of my galleries got the most views recently?
